definition.simple: A tiny, positively charged particle found in the very center (nucleus) of an atom.
definition.academic: A subatomic particle occurring in all atomic nuclei, with a positive electric charge equal in magnitude to that of an electron, but of opposite sign.

common_misconceptions: Protons move around the atom. (False: They are locked in the nucleus)
ai_context.tutor_hint: The number of protons determines what element the atom is. If you change the protons, you change the element!
